maddeler.e:
تكاشفت (form VI)
# تَكَاشَفْتُ (takāšaftu) /ta.kaː.ʃaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَاشَفَ (takāšafa)
# تَكَاشَفْتَ (takāšafta) /ta.kaː.ʃaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَاشَفَ (takāšafa)
# تَكَاشَفْتِ (takāšafti) /ta.kaː.ʃaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَاشَفَ (takāšafa)
# تَكَاشَفَتْ (takāšafat) /ta.kaː.ʃa.fat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
